messages:
Maya Patel: Post-launch quick check: we need a lightweight process to decide fixes vs enhancements. Proposal: 48h patch window for P0/P1, then 2-week enhancement slice. Agree?

Ethan Cole: Agree. Suggest concrete triage gates: customer-blocking, core-flow break, or regression -> patch. Anything else -> enhancement.

Rina Alvarez: Can we require a short repro + impact count for patch candidates? Support can stub those in the ticket.

Sam Rivera: Yep. Also cap patch work to <6h dev when possible. If >6h, tag as "deferred-hotfix" and include ETA in customer comms.

Maya Patel: Ops constraints: Dedicated pool maintenance tonight. Ops will only approve critical canaries. Rina, Sam -> flag infra needs in ticket.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: dedicated-gpu-cluster from 2026-03-21T22:00Z to 2026-03-22T04:00Z.

Ethan Cole: I'll add a minimal triage template to the board and label rules (patch/p0, patch/p1, enhancement).

Maya Patel: Plan: owners assigned within 1 hour, daily triage at 11:00, support to post repro & customers notified within 2 hours for P0s. Add candidates to the "postlaunch-ops" column by EOD. Short updates only in thread. :+1:
